meta.name: dot-ai-generate-cicd
meta.description: Generate intelligent CI/CD workflows through interactive conversation by analyzing repository structure and user preferences

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过对话分析仓库结构，自动生成CI/CD工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望用自然语言描述需求就能生成CI/CD配置
copy.tagline_en: Generate CI/CD workflows by analyzing repo structure through conversation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate CI/CD configs by describing needs in natural language

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你的代码仓库，然后通过对话询问你的偏好，最后生成适合你项目的 CI/CD 工作流文件。
howto.when: 当你要求为当前项目生成 CI/CD 工作流时触发。Claude 会先问你要用哪个平台（如 GitHub Actions），然后逐步分析仓库并和你确认选项。

say.text: 帮我为这个项目生成 CI/CD 工作流。
say.note: Claude 会开始分析仓库并询问你的偏好。

say.text: 我想用 GitHub Actions 做 CI/CD，帮我设置一下。
say.note: Claude 会确认平台后继续分析。

say.text: 检查一下我的仓库，然后生成合适的工作流。
say.note: Claude 会分析代码并给出选项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your code repository, asks about your preferences through conversation, and then generates CI/CD workflow files suitable for your project.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate CI/CD workflows for the current project. Claude first asks which platform (e.g., GitHub Actions) to use, then analyzes the repository and confirms choices with you step by step.

say_en.text: Generate CI/CD workflows for this project.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the repo and ask your preferences.

say_en.text: I want to use GitHub Actions for CI/CD, please set it up.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm the platform and proceed.

say_en.text: Analyze my repo and generate appropriate workflows.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze code and present options.
